Definition: of Hebrew origin (compare H3672); Gennesaret (i.e. Kinnereth), a lake and plain in Palestine:--Gennesaret.
BiblicalUsage: Gennēsarét is a lake and plain in Palestine, named 3 times in Scripture, in Matthew, Mark, and Luke. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God met His people at Gennēsarét, a real place in His story, and that is why I take its name seriously. I hold that even a place the Bible names only briefly is worth knowing.
RelatedEvents: The Feeding of the Five Thousand; The Calling of the First Disciples
